summary: Mercury General Corporation filed an 8-K to report the completion of a public offering of $525.0 million aggregate principal amount of 6.250% Senior Notes due 2036. The notes were issued at 99.764% of par, are unsecured senior obligations ranking equally with existing and future unsecured senior debt, and were issued under an indenture with Wilmington Trust as trustee. Interest is payable semi-annually, and the notes mature June 15, 2036. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction—a simple note issuance with standard covenants and customary events of default—not a special situation.
